groups.name: mateu
groups.description: Mateu: model-driven UIs. Every key is also read as a JVM system property or as the MATEU_* environment variable (dots and dashes become underscores).

properties.name: mateu.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call Mateu's API (/mateu/**) from another origin. CORS is off while it is unset; never use * together with credentials.

properties.name: mateu.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether cross-origin calls to Mateu's API may carry credentials (cookies, Authorization).

properties.name: mateu.cors.paths
properties.description: Extra comma-separated path patterns the CORS allow-list covers besides Mateu's API, e.g. /elements/** for modules a shell on another origin imports.

properties.name: mateu.actions.strict
properties.description: Strict action mode: an actionId runs only a marked method or one the view advertises; anything else is refused with 403.

properties.name: mateu.errors.detailed
properties.description: Show the raw exception in the error toast instead of the generic message with a reference id. For development only.

properties.name: mateu.listing.max-page-size
properties.description: Largest page size a listing search may ask for; larger or non-positive sizes are capped to it.

properties.name: mateu.layout.inference.enabled
properties.description: Infer form layouts (folded optional fields, sections as tabs, small enums as radio buttons) for every class without @AutoLayout.

properties.name: mateu.page.inference.enabled
properties.description: Page-level inference: a plain class whose shape is a dashboard or a welcome page is composed as one. @AutoPage(false) opts a class out.

properties.name: mateu.ui.modules
properties.description: Comma-separated packages of third-party Mateu UI modules (jars of @UI screens) to mount in this application.

properties.name: mateu.public-base-path
properties.description: Path a reverse proxy strips in front of the app (e.g. /crm), so the served page links its assets and routes under it.

properties.name: mateu.trust-forwarded-prefix
properties.description: Honour the X-Forwarded-Prefix header as the public base path when mateu.public-base-path is not set. Only behind a proxy that always overwrites it.

properties.name: mateu.forwarded-prefix.trusted
properties.description: Other spelling of mateu.trust-forwarded-prefix.

properties.name: mateu.mcp.enabled
properties.description: Serve the MCP endpoint (/mateu/mcp) that lets AI agents operate and author the UIs.

properties.name: mateu.mcp.task-timeout-seconds
properties.description: How long an MCP tool call waits for a long task it started before cancelling it.

properties.name: mateu.mcp.push.enabled
properties.description: Let MCP callers push UI to an open UI (live UI push). Needs mateu.mcp.enabled too.

properties.name: mateu.telemetry.enabled
properties.description: OpenTelemetry spans and metrics for every Mateu request (only when the OpenTelemetry API is on the classpath).

properties.name: mateu.static-assets.compression
properties.description: Serve the renderer's text assets gzipped.

properties.name: mateu.static-assets.caching
properties.description: Cache headers for the renderer's assets: content-versioned paths immutable, the rest revalidated.

properties.name: mateu.pwa.enabled
properties.description: Serve every UI as an installable web app (manifest, service worker, icons). Always off in development mode.

properties.name: mateu.security.csrf-exemption.enabled
properties.description: Exempt Mateu's JSON calls from Spring Security's CSRF check (they cannot be sent cross-site without CORS).

properties.name: mateu.uploads.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret signing file upload tickets. Random per process when unset; every instance behind a load balancer must share it.

properties.name: mateu.uploads.max-bytes
properties.description: Largest file the upload endpoint accepts when the field declares no limit.

properties.name: mateu.uploads.max-files-per-ticket
properties.description: How many files one upload ticket of a multiple-file field may send.

properties.name: mateu.idempotency.max-entries
properties.description: Finished answers remembered for Idempotency-Key replays (in memory, per process).

properties.name: mateu.idempotency.max-entries-per-caller
properties.description: Idempotency keys one caller may hold at a time.

properties.name: mateu.idempotency.ttl-seconds
properties.description: How long a finished answer is remembered for Idempotency-Key replays.

properties.name: mateu.remotes
properties.description: Comma-separated ids of the remote Mateu backends micro frontends may be resolved against; each one is configured with mateu.remotes.<id>.base-url, .timeout-ms and .identity.

properties.name: mateu.self-base-url
properties.description: Base url this server calls itself at, for remotes declared with a path base url. Defaults to the local socket.

properties.name: mateu.remote.allowed-hosts
properties.description: Optional comma-separated allow-list of hosts (host or host:port) remote calls may reach; any other host is refused.

properties.name: mateu.microfrontends.default-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout of one server-resolved micro frontend call when it declares none.

properties.name: mateu.microfrontends.max-budget-ms
properties.description: Cap of the time a page waits for its server-resolved micro frontends before degrading them to the browser.

properties.name: mateu.content-slots.remote
properties.description: Remote id @ContentSlot fields ask for their content.

properties.name: mateu.content-slots.route
properties.description: Route a content slot asks its remote for; {key} is replaced by the slot key.

properties.name: mateu.content-slots.descriptor.enabled
properties.description: Answer the __content_slots__ action that lists every content slot of the application.

properties.name: mateu.oracle-cdn.url
properties.description: Mirror of https://static.oracle.com/cdn the Redwood renderer's page loads from instead of Oracle's CDN. Unset = Oracle's CDN.

properties.name: mateu.build-id
properties.description: Replaces the computed build id sent in the X-Mateu-Build header (renderers offer a reload when it changes).

properties.name: mateu.environment
properties.description: Name of the specs/ui environment (environments/<name>.yaml) whose REST source overrides apply.

properties.name: mateu.sources.mock
properties.description: Sample mode: REST sources with sample data answer it instead of calling their endpoint; writes succeed without persisting.

properties.name: mateu.dev
properties.description: Development mode: specs/ui read from the source tree with live reload, and the authoring tools.

properties.name: mateu.dev.specs-dir
properties.description: Comma-separated directories development mode reads specs/ui from.

properties.name: mateu.i18n.fallback
properties.description: Locale used when the request's locale has no translation catalogue or lacks a key.

properties.name: mateu.locale
properties.description: BCP 47 language tag (es, pt-BR) every request gets as its UI language instead of the browser's Accept-Language. Unset = the browser's language; an invalid value is ignored with one warning.

properties.name: mateu.client-log.enabled
properties.description: Accept the browser error reports the renderers send (logged under the mateu.client logger).

properties.name: mateu.client-log.max-reports-per-minute
properties.description: Browser error reports accepted per client and minute.

properties.name: mateu.bundle.endpoint.enabled
properties.description: Serve GET /mateu/v3/bundle, which renders every screen as a static bundle for whoever asks.

properties.name: mateu.documents.ttl-seconds
properties.description: How long a generated document's one-time download link stays valid.

properties.name: mateu.progress.reattach-grace-seconds
properties.description: How long a running long task waits for a client that left to reattach before it is cancelled (0 = cancel at once).

properties.name: mateu.push.expo.enabled
properties.description: Send remote push notifications through Expo's push service (fixed native builds only).
